content: Manual FTP deploys without version control risk: partial/interrupted uploads leaving the live site in a broken mixed-version state, no audit trail of what changed when, no rollback path, and 'missed file' bugs where an updated page references an asset that wasn't uploaded. Mitigation: keep a git repo as source of truth even if deploy is FTP, tag/snapshot before each deploy, and keep a full pre-deploy backup of the live public_html downloaded locally for instant manual rollback.
